name: wpf-minimize
description: Sub-recipe: minimize the WPF counter fixture window (one step, reusable prelude) and check the frame button flipped.
notes: Sub-recipe: no launch block, because a wrapper owns the launch and the target. The check is the frame button's own label: it reads 'Minimize' while restored and 'Restore' while iconic, so this proves the window actually parked. Consequence, measured: this file only works on a restored window - replaying it on an already-iconic one fails with `no Button "Minimize" ... nearest: [2] Button "Restore"`, so use wpf-restore as its counterpart rather than running it twice. After it, the window is iconic (183x34 @-31992,-32000): semantic clicks still land, coordinates and screenshots do not.
